verdict.rationale: Grafana documents first-party AI features like Grafana Assistant, natural-language querying ('understand production systems faster using natural language'), a knowledge graph generating insights across metrics/logs/traces without complex queries, and AI observability monitoring—these are AI-generated insights delivered inside the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Assistant's insight quality, and detail on how broadly these AI features are rolled out versus still emerging/Cloud-only.
